reason: For eligible MTN customers trying the new app for the first time: check My Gifts after your first authenticated login for the data reward.
caution: MTN decides eligibility. Claim within 24 hours of notification; redeemed data lasts 24 hours. Download costs may apply.

reason: For SA adults who prefer an online quiz to a qualifying purchase: complete the Slab Settler and registration for the weekly cash draw.
caution: Own RICA-registered number and data needed. The FAQ says website entry is purchase-free, but general terms still mention proof-of-purchase checks. Confirm winner requirements before entering.

reason: An online quiz route for SA adults who want to avoid a qualifying purchase. Complete the Slab Settler and registration rather than the separate in-store mechanic.
caution: Own RICA-registered number required; data costs and winner-document checks apply. The general terms retain proof-of-purchase validation wording despite the FAQ's purchase-free website route.

reason: For SPAR Rewards shoppers already buying the listed products: a qualifying purchase and card swipe enter you automatically, with no recipe, quiz or photo submission.
caution: SA citizens aged 18+ only. Buy two participating products and swipe Rewards; check exact pack sizes. This is a purchase route, with one braai prize and no cash exchange.

reason: For adult home cooks already planning a Sea Harvest meal: enter a family or heritage recipe with your own dish photo for the grocery-voucher draw.
caution: Product and data costs apply. Entry grants ongoing unpaid reuse and adaptation of your recipe and photo; credit is not guaranteed. Closes at 23:59 SAST.

reason: Something to watch or hear without another subscription: explore international live TV, radio and webcams through Famelack, formerly TV.Garden.
caution: Data costs apply. South African access was reported successful; individual streams can be restricted or unavailable, and stream rights are not independently verified.

reason: Read or download African children’s picture books in the language choices offered by Book Dash.
caution: Digital files are free. Data, printing and physical delivery are not included; retain the required attribution.

reason: For drivers already using participating Astron forecourts: earn Xcash shopping rewards on qualifying fuel with an active Xtra Savings profile.
caution: Fuel must be bought. Scan or swipe before payment; monthly caps apply. Xcash is not cash or a discount at the pump.

reason: South African adults can enter to win the Mally products in their qualifying online cart, up to R3,000, without paying for an order.
caution: The rules require an identifiable abandoned checkout with your name, email and contact details. One entry per person; leave before placing or paying for the order.

reason: A purchase-free checkout entry for one prize of selected Mally products worth up to R3,000, with South African delivery.
caution: Complete the required contact details and leave the checkout without placing an order. Closes at 23:59 SAST on 22 November; one entry per adult resident.

reason: For shoppers already buying at participating SPAR stores: swipe a registered Rewards card to enter the daily shopping-refund draw.
caution: A purchase is required. Participating stores and the refund cap apply; a normal shop does not guarantee a win.

reason: Eligible Absa Rewards customers have until 15 November to complete the specified digital-card and online-purchase steps for the voucher draw.
caution: This is a purchase-required draw, not an automatic R200 reward. Card, residency and banking conditions apply.
